person.name: William Edward Jackson Sr
person.notes: [Created by split package 2026-11-27 from profile 439.] William Edward Jackson Sr, called Billy. UNPROVEN profile: split from the conflated William Jackson profile 439 under Jequan Davis's ruling of 2026-11-22, with identity, dates, and family as researched on 2026-11-22 (split research register, item 1). Born Oct 1930 near Millsboro (SSDI-derived listings give 7 Oct 1930; the Mitsawokett family-history pages give 9 Oct 1930; the two-day discrepancy is unresolved, so the birth is carried at month precision). Died 15 Jul 2003 at Millsboro; buried 19 Jul 2003 in Harmony Cemetery, Millsboro. Son of Samuel Jackson and Agnes Beatrice Wright. Married Allece Dorene Clark, daughter of Walter Linford Clark and Arzelia Ellen Morris (no profile for her yet, so no spouse link). His children, named here until their own profiles exist: William E. Jackson Jr., Kevin W. Jackson, and Horace K. Jackson Sr.
